purpose: Teach: オリックス/テレビ朝日/スズキ/男優/ソビエト/ケニア/司馬/ブルジョアジー

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、オリックスのファンだったな
lines.en: Riku, you were into the Orix, weren't you?
lines.style: Playful accusation. Teasing lilt on the observation. Light rhythm, like she's been collecting these facts. Warm underneath—testing him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テレビ朝日の音楽番組観てたな、桜
lines.en: And you watched that music show on TV Asahi all the time, Sakura.
lines.style: Caught-out but unbothered. Slight deflection-humor in the tone. Quick comeback. A little embarrassed but mostly amused by her noticing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、スズキの軽自動車だったな
lines.en: And your family's got that Suzuki kei-car in the driveway.
lines.style: Building momentum now. Faster, more confident. Grinning in her voice. Each detail stacked like evidence in a friendly court case.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、男優志望って言ってたな、桜
lines.en: You said you wanted to be an actor, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. No judgment—just stating what he knows. Slight pause before her name, like he's waiting for her reaction.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、世界史でソビエト連邦習ったろ?
lines.en: You definitely covered the Soviet Union in world history, right?
lines.style: Rhythm picks up slightly. Rhythm matching hers now. Same conspiratorial energy—he's got ammunition too. Slight head tilt in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ケニアのマラソン選手憧れてたな、桜
lines.en: You've always admired those Kenyan marathon runners, haven't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Warmth creeping in. Less teasing now, more genuine fondness. Slight softness on her name. He remembers the small things about her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、司馬遼太郎の坂の上の雲読んでたな
lines.en: You read that Shiba Ryotaro—*The Cloud Above the Hill*—didn't you?
lines.style: Slower now. Quieter. The teasing has morphed into something more tender. Slight reverence in how he says the title. He's not trying to catch her anymore.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でブルジョアジー習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You studied the bourgeoisie in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Soft landing. Gentle rhythm. No edge now. Almost a whisper of a smile. He's let the game become something else—a quiet, close conversation.
